description: Read one comment in full: what the reviewer said, the element it is pinned to, its status, priority, labels, assignee and replies, plus the screenshot of what the reviewer saw, returned as an image. Use it when the user asks about a specific comment, or to look at the screenshot before making a change. To read every comment on a page at once, use get_comments instead.

include_screenshot.description: Return the reviewer's screenshot as an image. Default true.

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page, like https://htmlannotate.com/manage/<page>#k=<key>

number.description: The comment number as shown by get_comments, like 3 for #3.

name: get_comment
title: Read one comment
